title: SMOK TFOS Pod Vape Kit
description: The SMOK TFOS is a straightforward pod vape kit designed for day-to-day reliability and an easy setup. A built-in 1700mAh battery powers two simple output modes: choose Normal for steady, efficient performance or switch to Boost for a stronger draw. Operation is inhale-activated, so there are no firing buttons to press, and the large 1.86” screen keeps your battery level and vaping data easy to read at a glance. Airflow is adjustable via a small slider, letting you set a tighter MTL (mouth-to-lung) pull or open it for a looser RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) inhale. The refillable TFOS pod holds up to 2ml of e-liquid and uses a side-fill port to keep top-ups clean. An integrated 0.8ohm mesh coil is designed to deliver consistent flavour with 50/50 freebase or nicotine salt e-liquids. Finished in a compact, pocket-friendly chassis, the TFOS is available in Blue, Pink, Red, Black and Silver. Explore our vape juice uk and discover a delicious companion for this kit. We recommend pairing this kit with 50/50 (Freebase) or Nic Salts E-Liquid Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
